fields.meta_title: Case Study Form Builder for Customer Stories | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a case study form that gets before and after numbers and logo permission from each customer in one submission. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Case Study Form That Gets the Numbers First
fields.hero_description: Build a case study form that asks for each result with its starting number, then saves every story in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What the Writer Needs Before the First Draft
fields.features_subheading: A case study form collects what a writer needs to draft a customer story: the proof behind each result and what may be shown.
fields.feature_1:
Questions in the order the story runs

The form asks about the problem first, then what the customer changed, then the result. Answers arrive in the order a draft is written, with the problem at the top of the record.
fields.feature_2:
A starting number for every result

Each result question asks for the figure before and the figure now, with the month each was measured. A claim like faster invoicing arrives as 9 days down to 4, ready to quote.
fields.feature_3:
Permission asked asset by asset

Customers answer yes or no for the logo, their name, a headshot, and revenue figures. A revenue figure marked private stays out of the record, and the draft is written without it.
fields.feature_4:
Logo files and screenshots stay attached

Upload fields take logo files and product screenshots. Each file is saved in the same record as the answers it belongs to, next to the customer's permission for using it on the page.
fields.feature_5:
A Slack post when a story comes in

Each submission posts to the marketing channel in Slack or emails the writer assigned to that account. A customer who stops halfway gets a reminder with the link a week later.
fields.feature_6:
Your code, in your own repository

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and host the form wherever the rest of the marketing site runs. Keep building on it in any code editor you like.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Sends the Form, and What Comes Back
fields.tab_content_1:
Both numbers in, or the story waits

Shiftlane, a staff scheduling app, sends its case study form 90 days after go-live. It asks for a name, a company, and the weekly hours the crew schedule took before and takes now. Maribel Quinto at Copperfield Movers enters 12 and 3, and her story turns Ready to draft once both are in.
fields.tab_content_2:
Its revenue stays private while order counts show

Lintwood Studio, a marketing agency, sends the form when a campaign wraps. Peregrine Pantry, a grocery delivery shop, says yes to its logo and the owner's name but marks revenue figures as private. The app saves the result as 1,240 online orders in the campaign quarter, with no revenue figure stored.
fields.tab_content_3:
Three Adult ESL stories for one grant report

Tutors at the Yarrowfield Literacy Project fill in a case study form when a learner reaches the goal set at intake, giving the learner's first name, the program, and the goal reached. Nanette Brisco, the development director, filters for Adult ESL. She adds the 3 stories she finds to a grant report.
fields.tab_content_4:
Any nomination over 25% posts to marketing

Customer success managers at Pinwheel Payroll nominate accounts on an internal form: the account, the result, and the percentage it moved. Any nomination over 25% posts to the customer stories channel in Slack. Ilse Marrow nominates Havelock Freight, where driver onboarding dropped to 6 days from 10.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Case Study Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to plan the questions and permissions for a case study form, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Decide who will read the finished story
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask about the problem in plain words
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Write down what may be published
fields.howto_step_1_des: Name the reader of the finished case study, such as a buyer in the same industry or a grant officer. That reader decides which questions earn a place. For a software buyer, ask for the hours saved; for a grant officer, ask for the goal the learner reached.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Open with the problem, in the customer's own words: what took too long and what it cost them. Keep each question to one topic, and give the answer box room for a few sentences instead of a single line.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Ask what each number was before and what it is today, and name the unit in the question, such as hours a week or days to close the books. Without the starting point, the writer has to email the customer for it later, and the draft stalls.
fields.howto_step_4_des: List every asset the page could use, such as the logo, a headshot, or revenue figures. Ask about each one separately, and save each answer alongside the story it belongs to.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the questions and the permission list into one prompt. Emergent builds the case study form, the database behind it, and a table where each story waits for a writer. Change any question later by asking in plain English.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Send it once the result shows
fields.howto_step_6_des: Send the link after the customer has had time to see a result, such as one full quarter after launch. Send one reminder a week later to anyone who has not finished, and route each finished story to whoever will write it up.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Fill it in with a story you already ran
fields.howto_step_7_des: Test the form with a customer story you published last year. Enter its real numbers and permissions, then check that the record shows both figures and the revenue setting, with every uploaded file beside the right answer.

faq_plan.q: What is a case study form?
faq_plan.a: A case study form is a questionnaire a business sends to a customer or colleague to collect the facts for a case study. It asks what went wrong before, what changed, and what may be published. The writer drafts the story from those answers instead of from scattered emails.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a case study form?
faq_plan.a: Write down the numbers and permissions the finished story needs. Describe all of it to Emergent's AI form builder in one prompt, and it builds the form and a database for the answers. Submit one real past story through it before the first customer sees the link.

faq_plan.q: What questions should a case study form ask?
faq_plan.a: Five things, in order: who the customer is, the problem before, why they chose the product, what changed, and the result with a before and after number. Close with permission questions for the logo and any figures. Ten to twelve questions cover all of it.

faq_plan.q: Can I use a case study form for internal projects?
faq_plan.a: Yes. An internal version asks the project lead for the team involved, the problem, the change they made, and the numbers before and after, then saves each story for the next company meeting. Keep opinions about the workplace itself out of it: those belong on an employee feedback form.

faq_plan.q: How long should a case study form be?
faq_plan.a: Aim for 10 to 12 questions, short enough to finish in about 15 minutes. Make the before and after numbers required and leave the rest optional, which lets a busy contact send what they have. Keep it online rather than mailing a case study form PDF: each answer is saved as it is submitted, and nobody retypes it.

faq_plan.q: How do I get customers to fill out a case study form?
faq_plan.a: Ask the person who saw the result, and tell them up front how long the form takes. Send it once the numbers have moved, then one reminder a week later. Ask Emergent to add the email reminder and a Slack post for each finished story.

faq_plan.q: Should a case study form also ask for a short quote?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add one question asking for a sentence or two about the result in the customer's own words, which the writer can lift into the story as a pull quote. If a short quote is all you need, a testimonial form is quicker for the customer to finish.

faq_plan.q: Can a case study form collect logo files and screenshots?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add an upload field for each asset and say in the label what you need: the logo as a vector file, screenshots at full size, and a headshot. A customer without a vector logo can say so in a short text field below it. Forms built with Emergent have no response caps.

faq_plan.q: Who should fill out a case study form at the customer's company?
faq_plan.a: The person who uses the product every day and saw the result firsthand. Add a second contact for approval, such as the manager who signs off on what the company says in public, and ask for that person's email on the form.

faq_plan.q: Can I use a case study form for student assignments?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Ask for the case title and the analysis in sections: the problem, the options considered, and the recommendation, with a file upload for the full write-up. If students also present the case in class, grade the talk with a presentation evaluation form.
